mutationSeams.reason: The state engine's own schema witness row.

Work-plane DDL. The only INSERTs are inside AFTER INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE triggers that bump the projection revision counter, so the write is SQLite's and local to the row, which is exactly why no call path can bypass it.

Crew DDL contributes exactly one revision-counter INSERT inside a SQLite trigger: task-verdict INSERT. It invalidates the affected canvas projection in the same transaction as its crew row. No application statement writes the derived counter, and this declaration owns no crew storage table.

THE EVENT JOURNAL APPEND. SQLite is the factory world's append-only journal and this file is the only place a journal record is written: allocateSequence / rememberIncomingSequence number a route, appendWorkRecord writes the record envelope plus its command / fact / disposition variant, appendPendingCommand indexes a command as unresolved. It decides nothing — minting, authority, and materialization stay in repository.ts. The runtime half of the same law is work/mutation-seam.ts, which refuses a projection write that no append here explains.
mutationSeams.retire: The four record tables plus work_event_sequences are the destination shape and stay. work_pending_commands is the debt: it is a derived index of unresolved commands, so once the in-memory world holds that index it leaves this file's table set and the entry becomes permanent.

journalFreeMutations.reason: Two operator artifact operations mutate the projection and mint no fact: set_archived rewrites metadata_json in place, delete removes the row with no tombstone. Neither replicates, and a rebuild from the journal loses the archive flag and resurrects the deleted artifact. Atomic task and standalone-commit verdict admission also delegates to crew-repository.applyVerdictWrite under crew.review-verdict: only the immutable Command Center-local work_review_verdicts row escapes the work journal, after live subject, author and reviews-edge checks. A blocking task transition remains journaled; crew-repository retains sole ownership of the verdict INSERT.
journalFreeMutations.retire: Mint artifact.archive and artifact.retract facts and materialize them, then delete those two reasons. Remove crew.review-verdict from this call-site entry if verdict admission no longer posts journal-free rows; if verdicts ever replicate, mint review.verdict facts and materialize them before retiring the closed reason.

journalFreeMutations.reason: The crew durable store writes Command Center-local operational state that must never replicate: immutable seat-stamped review verdicts, receipt-feed dedupe rows, and coalesced checkout commit observations.
